admin.custom_emojis.title.description: Heading of the custom emoji screen, and its link in the administration menu.

admin.custom_emojis.summary.defaultMessage: Registra los emoji personalizados de este servidor y desactiva los de otros servidores.
admin.custom_emojis.summary.description: Description of the custom emoji screen in the administration menu of the settings.

admin.custom_emojis.new.title.description: Heading of the form that registers a custom emoji of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.image.description: Label of the image of a custom emoji, in the form and in an emoji's details.

admin.custom_emojis.image.description.defaultMessage: PNG, GIF o WebP, de como máximo 1024 píxeles por lado. Se muestra dentro de 256 píxeles; un PNG animado muestra solo su primer fotograma.
admin.custom_emojis.image.description.description: Help of the image of a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.image.choose.description: Button that opens the file chooser for the image of a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.image.chosen.description: The image file chosen for a new custom emoji. {name} is the file name.

admin.custom_emojis.image.large_hint.defaultMessage: Esta imagen pesa más de 100 KB. Algunos servidores (GoToSocial por defecto) no muestran emoji tan grandes.
admin.custom_emojis.image.large_hint.description: Note under a chosen custom emoji image larger than 100 KB; it can still be registered.

admin.custom_emojis.image.required.description: Error of the custom emoji form submitted without an image.

admin.custom_emojis.image_failed.defaultMessage: El servidor no pudo procesar la imagen.
admin.custom_emojis.image_failed.description: Reason of a failed registration or image replacement when the server could not process the uploaded image.

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.description: Label of the shortcode of a new custom emoji: the name people type between colons.

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.descriptio.defaultMessage: De 2 a 30 letras (de A a Z), dígitos y guiones bajos; las mayúsculas cuentan. La gente lo escribe entre dos puntos, como :blobcat:. No se puede cambiar después.
admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.descriptio.description: Help of the shortcode of a new custom emoji. :blobcat: is an example (not translated).

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.defaultMessage: Usa de 2 a 30 letras (de A a Z), dígitos y guiones bajos.
admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.description: Error of a shortcode that is empty or breaks the rules.

admin.custom_emojis.category.description: Label of the category that groups a custom emoji in the picker.

admin.custom_emojis.category.description.defaultMessage: Agrupa los emoji en el selector. Opcional, de hasta {max} caracteres.
admin.custom_emojis.category.description.description: Help of the category of a custom emoji. {max} is the most characters.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description: Label of the other names that the picker's search finds a custom emoji by.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description.defaultMessage: Nombres por los que la búsqueda del selector también encuentra el emoji, separados por espacios o comas; hasta {max}, cada uno con forma de código corto.
admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description.description: Help of the other names of a custom emoji. {max} is the most names.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.too_many.description: Error of more other names than allowed. {max} is the most names.

admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.description: Checkbox of whether the picker offers a custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.de.defaultMessage: Un emoji oculto en el selector puede seguir escribiéndose con su :código_corto:.
admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.de.description: Help of the checkbox of whether the picker offers a custom emoji. :shortcode: is not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.created_by.description: Term of the description list of a local custom emoji: the account of the user who made it.

admin.custom_emojis.created_by.deleted.description: Value of 'Made by' for a custom emoji whose creator's account is deleted.

admin.custom_emojis.created_by.none.description: Value of 'Made by' for a custom emoji registered with the my command, not by a user.

admin.custom_emojis.pages.pending.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# solicitud pendiente de revisión} other {# solicitudes pendientes de revisión}}
admin.custom_emojis.pages.pending.description: Visually hidden words of the badge on the link to the requests page: the number of requests that await review.

admin.custom_emojis.pages.pending_more.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Más de # solicitud pendiente de revisión} other {Más de # solicitudes pendientes de revisión}}
admin.custom_emojis.pages.pending_more.description: Visually hidden words of the badge on the link to the requests page when there are more pending requests than the first page holds.

admin.custom_emojis.submit.description: Button that registers a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.create_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo registrar el emoji personalizado: {reason}

admin.custom_emojis.list.title.description: Heading of the list of custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.remote_add.description: Shown in place of the button that registers an emoji, while the list shows the emoji of other servers.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the select in the toolbar of the custom emoji list that chooses the emoji of this server or of other servers.

admin.custom_emojis.search.submit.description: Button of the search form of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.description: Heading of the custom emoji list of this server when none is registered.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.descript.description: Description of the empty custom emoji list of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.remote.defaultMessage: No hay emoji personalizados de otros servidores
admin.custom_emojis.empty.remote.description: Heading of the custom emoji list of other servers when none has been seen.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.search.description: Heading of the custom emoji list when the search finds nothing.

admin.custom_emojis.domain.description: Term in a remote custom emoji's details: the domain it came from.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.hidden.description: Value of the picker term: the picker does not offer the emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.none.description: Value of a custom emoji's category or other names when it has none.

admin.custom_emojis.no_image.defaultMessage: No se muestra (el servidor de origen tiene rechazado su contenido multimedia)
admin.custom_emojis.no_image.description: Value of a remote custom emoji's image when the server does not show it, because a domain action rejects the media of its server.

admin.custom_emojis.updated_at.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: when its current image was set.

admin.custom_emojis.save.description: Button that saves the settings of a custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.change_failed.defaultMessage: No se pudo cambiar el emoji personalizado: {reason}
admin.custom_emojis.change_failed.description: Error when changing, replacing the image of, or deleting a custom emoji failed. {reason} is the localized reason.

admin.custom_emojis.replace_image.description: Button of a custom emoji that chooses a new image file for it.

admin.custom_emojis.image_replaced.defaultMessage: Se reemplazó la imagen de {emoji}. Los demás servidores la vuelven a descargar.
admin.custom_emojis.image_replaced.description: Status after replacing the image of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.delete.description: Button of a custom emoji that deletes it, and the confirm button of its dialog.

admin.custom_emojis.deleted.description: Status after deleting a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.copy.description: Title of the region of a remote emoji's page that copies it into an emoji of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.description.defaultMessage: Este servidor descarga la imagen y la registra como emoji propio, que aparece en el selector. La imagen se reduce a 256 píxeles como máximo.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.submit.description: Confirm button of the dialog that copies another server's custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.enable_emoji.description: Accessible name of the enable button of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.disabled_status.description: Status after disabling a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.enabled_status.description: Status after enabling a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.pages.requests.description: Link of the local navigation to the requests for custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.column.emoji.description: Column header of the emoji: its image and :shortcode:, a link to its page.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.title.description: Heading and title of the page of one custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.about.description: Title of the region of an emoji's page with its image, :shortcode: and facts.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.settings.description: Title of the region of a local emoji's page with the form of its category, other names and picker visibility.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.image.description: Title of the region of a local emoji's page that replaces its image.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.state.description: Title of the region of an emoji's page that enables or disables it.

admin.custom_emojis.detail.state.descrip.defaultMessage: Un emoji desactivado no aparece en ningún sitio, ni en publicaciones, perfiles, federación ni selector: su :código_corto: se muestra como texto.
